---
title: "Demo A: quarto-live's own reactivity"
# What `format: live-html` would do. In a book, a page's own `format` is
# ignored (the book's html format wins), so enable quarto-live directly.
# A page's `filters` replace the book-wide list, so macros.lua is repeated.
filters:
  - ../filters/macros.lua
  - ../_extensions/r-wasm/live/live.lua
ojs-engine: true
engine: markdown
webr:
  packages: [knitr]   # quarto-live converts `define`d values with knitr::knit_print
---

This demo uses only what quarto-live provides. Drag the person; the spring force is computed by R in your browser, and the figure, the code and the equation follow.

The force on the person is $F = -k\,(x_1 - L_0)$.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { d3 } from "../lib/js/kit/index.js"
import { draw, interact } from "../lib/js/figures/spring1.js"

L0 = 2

// Placeholder until R defines F (quarto-live then redefines this variable).
F = null

// The figure is an OJS "view": dragging changes its value, x1.
viewof x1 = {
  const svg = d3.create("svg");
  const node = svg.node();
  let state = { x: 3, L0, F: NaN };
  draw(svg, state);
  node.value = state.x;
  interact(svg, state, (s) => {
    state = { ...state, x: s.x };
    draw(svg, { ...state, F: node.lastF });   // move at once, with the last known force
    node.value = s.x;
    timing.sent += 1;
    timing.lastSent = performance.now();
    node.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  return node;
}

// Plain object, mutated in place (no reactivity needed)
timing = ({ sent: 0, received: 0, lastSent: 0, lags: [] })
```

**The R code that runs** (a quarto-live `{webr}` cell; `x1` comes from the figure):

```{webr}
#| input: [x1]
#| define: [F]
#| edit: false
k  <- 2
L0 <- 2
F  <- -k * (x1 - L0)
```

**The same code with the current value filled in** (a quarto-live interpolated block; it is *displayed* only, not run):

```r
x1 <- ${x1}
k  <- 2
L0 <- 2
F  <- -k * (x1 - L0)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Runs whenever R defines a new F: redraw with the force, and record the lag
// between the latest drag event and this result.
forceDrawn = {
  if (F === null) return null;
  const f = F[0];                       // `define` delivers R vectors as arrays
  const node = viewof x1;
  node.lastF = f;
  draw(d3.select(node), { x: x1, L0, F: f });
  if (F !== timing.lastF) {               // count new results from R only
    timing.lastF = F;
    timing.received += 1;
    if (timing.lastSent) timing.lags.push(performance.now() - timing.lastSent);
  }
  window.hnDemoTiming = timing;
  return f;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
eq = {
  const el = html`<div style="text-align:center"></div>`;
  const f = forceDrawn === null ? "\\ ?" : forceDrawn.toFixed(2);
  window.katex.render(
    `F = -k\\,(x_1 - L_0) = -2\\,(${x1.toFixed(2)} - 2) = ${f}\\ \\mathrm{N}`,
    el, { displayMode: true });
  return el;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
stats = {
  forceDrawn;   // update after each result
  const lags = timing.lags.slice(-30);
  const avg = lags.length ? lags.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / lags.length : 0;
  const max = lags.length ? Math.max(...lags) : 0;
  return md`<small id="hn-stats">Drag events sent to R: **${timing.sent}**, results received: **${timing.received}**; lag from latest drag to result (last 30): average **${avg.toFixed(0)} ms**, max **${max.toFixed(0)} ms**</small>`;
}
```
